column1: # Campaign 25 source evidence for configured FullSchema join planning.

column5: ConfiguredJoinPlan preserves physical FullSchema as left columns then right columns, keeps one non-null signed-BIGINT cross-side equality, routes local conditions into the owning scans, and coalesces one USING key in visible metadata without removing the redundant right physical column; semi, anti, null-aware, outer joins, predicate derivation, reorder, statistics, and physical alternatives remain open.

The bounded join publishes immutable physical FullSchema columns, visible FullSchema offsets, and source-order direct projection offsets with stable table and column identities; general schema propagation, names, BaseLogicalPlan children, full FieldType/collation/VirtualExpr metadata, hashing, and arbitrary operators remain open.

The configured join admits only already-aligned non-null signed BIGINT equality and explicitly rejects NullEQ or unsupported condition shapes, so no implicit cast is invented; INT/VARCHAR coercion, guard selections, projection rewrite, outer-side preservation, and the general join-key type-cast rule remain open.
